Every channel of the source is checked against the whitelist before every fetch and any failure refuses the whole source with an alert; channels are interleaved in config order with no commission or rebate weight; no_rebate and abnormal prices are dropped; at most one refill round; a per-channel upstream page cursor; a union failure of one channel only drops it (D10-473, same as search.ts isFeedFailure; programming errors rethrow). Cards are computed for the current viewer, carry ad_label null, register under scene feed and are marked stale when an old copy is served during a union failure. PageReader.section reads as getPage but skips condition. The category blocklist is not applied: UnionItem has no category field (FU-CATEGORY-BLOCKLIST, TODO in code). The whitelist is empty today, so production answers empty; real adapters wait for CAP-*-10. No HTTP test covers the controller, it passed smoke:entries only. No money moves. verify:fast exit 0 (api 3696, spec-tests 20740). Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
